definitions.explanation: The act of replacing one person or thing with another in rotation.
The changing of workers at the end of a work period.

examples.japanese: {選手|せんしゅ}{交替|こうたい}があった。
{運転|うんてん}を{交替|こうたい}しながら{旅行|りょこう}した。
{世代|せだい}{交替|こうたい}が{進|すす}み、{若|わか}い{社員|しゃいん}が{中心|ちゅうしん}になってきた。
examples.english: Generational change has progressed, and younger employees have become the core.

examples.japanese: {次|つぎ}の{交替|こうたい}は{何時|なんじ}ですか。
examples.english: What time is the next shift change?

examples.japanese: {夜勤|やきん}の{交替|こうたい}{時間|じかん}になった。
examples.english: It's time for the night shift change.

examples.japanese: {交替|こうたい}{勤務|きんむ}は{体|からだ}に{負担|ふたん}がかかるので、{健康|けんこう}{管理|かんり}が{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: Shift work puts a strain on the body, so health management is important.

notes:
KANJI NOTE: Also commonly written as {交代|こうたい} with a different kanji but the same meaning.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{交替|こうたい}する (to alternate, to take turns)
・{交替|こうたい}{勤務|きんむ} (shift work)
・{世代|せだい}{交替|こうたい} (generational change)
・{選手|せんしゅ}{交替|こうたい} (player substitution)
